title: ArgenCraft
description:
This mod has food, references, structures and a lot more of references to the Argentine culture.

This mod is also currently in development phase, any suggestion will be acepted, (Please leave a comment)
body:
Spanish: En este mod vas a poder encontrar comidas, referencias, construcciones y mucho más referente a la cultura argentina.
Este mod se encuentra en etapa de desarrollo, cualquier sugerencia es aceptada, (porfavor dejá tu comentario).

English: This mod has food, references, structures and a lot more of references to the Argentine culture.
This mod is also currently in development phase, any suggestion will be acepted, (Please leave a comment)
